## What is Magic City Savers?

Magic City Savers helps people who shop at more than one grocery store find the best weekly deals in one place.

We're starting in central Birmingham neighborhoods like Avondale, Crestwood, Forest Park, Homewood, and nearby areas. Right now, we review weekly sales across local stores and share:

### Standout grocery deals

The best prices across Birmingham stores

### Simple meal ideas

Recipes based on what's on sale

If this proves useful, we plan to expand by tracking prices over time and helping people see which store (or combination of stores) actually saves the most.

We're collecting early feedback to guide what we build next. If you want to help, you can take our [short survey](https://form.typeform.com/to/xSQpqhcp).

# How to Save Money on Groceries in Birmingham

Groceries are expensive, and finding good deals shouldn't feel like a second job.

Magic City Savers helps Birmingham-area shoppers save money on groceries by highlighting the best weekly deals at local stores - all in one place.

## What Magic City Savers Does

Each week, we review grocery sales and promotions at major Birmingham-area stores and surface the deals that offer real value.

Instead of scrolling through multiple weekly ads or chasing coupons, you get a short, curated list of standout grocery deals - focused on food you'll actually use.

## Who It's For

Magic City Savers is for Birmingham shoppers who:

- Want to spend less on groceries
- Shop at multiple local stores
- Don't have time to compare weekly ads
- Prefer simple, practical savings over extreme couponing

If you buy groceries in Birmingham and want an easier way to find good deals, this is for you.

## How It Works

- 1 We review weekly grocery ads and promotions
- 2 We identify the best-value food deals
- 3 We share them through a free weekly email and on Instagram

That's it. No apps to manage. No coupons required.

## Stores We Cover

We regularly track deals at popular Birmingham-area grocery stores, including:

- 🛒 Publix
- 🛒 Aldi
- 🛒 Piggly Wiggly
- 🛒 Winn-Dixie
- 🛒 Walmart
- 🛒 Target

Store selection and deals vary week to week based on availability.

## What Makes It Different

Most deal sites focus on national coupons or household products. Magic City Savers focuses on local grocery deals and meal-friendly food items - tailored to how people actually shop in Birmingham.

We keep it simple, local, and practical.

## Get Weekly Grocery Deals

Magic City Savers is currently free while we build and improve the service.

Join the email list to get weekly grocery deals delivered straight to your inbox.

Early Project - Built With Community Feedback - No Spam

# About Magic City Savers

An independent local project, free and with no paywall, run from Innovation Depot in Birmingham.

## What We're Building

Magic City Savers is a hyper-local grocery savings club built for Birmingham neighborhoods. Our goal is simple: make it easy for shoppers to compare prices across nearby stores — like Aldi, Publix, Walmart, Piggly Wiggly, and more — so everyone can save money every week.

We're building tools that scrape and analyze grocery prices across multiple stores, letting you build a shopping list and see which store has the best deals in real time.

## Why This Matters

Grocery prices have climbed year after year, and shoppers often have no visibility into which store is truly cheapest for their weekly list. Many families in our area are spending far more than they need to — simply because the information is hard to find.

By gathering price data, listening to local shoppers, and focusing on a few neighborhoods at a time, we aim to create a tool that delivers real savings, week after week.

See what that looks like in practice: [this week's Birmingham grocery deals](https://magiccitysavers.com/deals.html), updated every Wednesday.
